summary: Full E2E test of 'Aziende preferite' (backend + frontend) and new homepage sections 'Noleggio Attrezzi' / 'Mercatino Usato'. 7/7 pytest cases passed. All frontend flows (anonymous, privato, azienda, dashboard, mobile menu) worked as specified. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_preferiti.py: PUT returns 200 but spec in some projects expects 201 on first insert. Current behavior is fine (idempotent 200/{saved:true}).

DashboardPrivato uses /dashboard route (not /dashboard/privato). dashboardPathFor('privato') correctly returns '/dashboard'. Review request text mentions /dashboard/privato but the actual URL per AuthContext is '/dashboard' — not a bug but worth noting in docs.
Mercatino usato first card image 'trapani' appeared unloaded in screenshot (dark/empty) though testid is present. External Unsplash/Pexels image availability can be flaky; consider local fallback.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed added. Preferito created during test was removed via DELETE in the dashboard flow — privato left with 0 preferiti.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_preferiti.py — reusable regression suite. Frontend dashboard route for privato is '/dashboard' (not '/dashboard/privato'). Heart testid pattern: preferita-toggle-{aziendaId}. Section order verified: categorie(1288) < noleggio(2000) < mercatino(2820) < come-funziona(3764).
